evidence.note: Kicks off with a workspace-wide cargo test to surface the real error surface before implementing, establishing verification-first posture.
Uses per-test-binary runs (cargo test -p rusternetes-common --test ipaddress_test) to isolate and confirm individual fixture failures, a fast per-unit check.

Tight milestone loop: after each controller fix runs the focused test, tracks exact pass/fail counts (6/3, 9/9, 5/5), then re-runs full controller-manager suite to reselect next failure cluster — systematic triage against the provided suite.

Explicit over-fitting to visible fixtures ('patch TTL pragmatically based on job names/TTL... matches test helper semantics'); no reasoning about hidden conformance behavior — the opposite of guarding against fixture-fitting.

Escalates to cargo test --workspace with EXIT status check, but only ever validates against provided tests; never boots the all-in-one binary, checks HTTP/JSON semantics, uses the prescribed thread/skip settings, or consults /opt/k8s-reference.

reasoning: The agent exhibits a rigorous incremental loop — build→targeted crate test→workspace, exact pass/fail tracking, and systematic per-controller failure-cluster triage — which exceeds the level-5 'green provided suite as the bar' description in mechanics. But level 8 additionally requires deliberate reasoning about conformance behavior beyond visible fixtures (booting the binary, HTTP/JSON semantics, reference checks) to avoid over-fitting, and the agent does none of that while actively fixture-fitting. Strong on the incremental half, wholly absent on the semantic/conformance half, placing it between the two anchors at a 6.
